components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Spaces, dashes and
            parentheses are accepted and stripped; the stored value is digits only.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When provided it must be unique across owners.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The display name of the pet owner, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The initials of the pet owner, formatted as the upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date
              description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current date when not supplied.
              type: string
              format: date
              example: '2013-01-01'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The sequential membership number assigned to the pet owner when created, equal to one more than the number of owners that existed at that time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 11
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The customer code assigned to the pet owner when created, formatted as '<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>' where NNNN is one more than the number of owners already in that city, zero-padded to four digits.
              type: string
              example: 'LONDON-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The membership tier assigned to the pet owner when created. The first 100 owners ever created are 'FOUNDING'; all later owners are 'STANDARD'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - FOUNDING
                - STANDARD
              example: 'FOUNDING'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of other owners that shared the same last name at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            sharesHousehold:

              description: Whether another owner already had the same address and city at the moment this owner was created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Spaces, dashes and
            parentheses are accepted and stripped; the stored value is digits only.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When provided it must be unique across owners.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The display name of the pet owner, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The initials of the pet owner, formatted as the upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date
              description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current date when not supplied.
              type: string
              format: date
              example: '2013-01-01'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The sequential membership number assigned to the pet owner when created, equal to one more than the number of owners that existed at that time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 11
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The customer code assigned to the pet owner when created, formatted as '<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>' where NNNN is one more than the number of owners already in that city, zero-padded to four digits.
              type: string
              example: 'LONDON-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The membership tier assigned to the pet owner when created. The first 100 owners ever created are 'FOUNDING'; all later owners are 'STANDARD'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - FOUNDING
                - STANDARD
              example: 'FOUNDING'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of other owners that shared the same last name at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            sharesHousehold:
              title: Shares household
              description: Whether another owner already had the same address and city at the moment this owner was created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "'local' if the owner's city was the single most common city among existing owners at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'remote'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - local
                - remote
              example: 'local'
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented the `locality` field on the owner-creation response. When creating an owner, the response now includes `locality` set to `"local"` if the owner's city is the *single* most common city among owners existing at that time, otherwise `"remote"`.

Changes made, following the same pattern as the existing derived fields (`namesakeCount`, `sharesHousehold`, etc.):

- **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` string property to the `Owner` schema (plain string, not an enum, so MapStruct maps the model's `String` cleanly — an enum would fail `valueOf` on the lowercase values).
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `locality` column field with getter/setter.
- **Schema files** (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres) — added a `locality VARCHAR(20)` column.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — calls `owner.setLocality(locality(owner))` before saving, plus a new `locality(...)` helper that groups existing owners by (whitespace/case-normalized) city, finds the max frequency, and returns `"local"` only when exactly one city holds that max and it matches the new owner's city; `"remote"` otherwise (including no existing owners or a tie).

The computation runs before the owner is persisted, so it reflects only pre-existing owners — matching the spec's "at that time."
